fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
    OR(
        ISBLANK($Setup.BorrowerPortalSettings__c.Lead_Borrower_Home_Url__c),
        ISBLANK(Portal_Hash_Parameter__c)
    ),
    "",
    SUBSTITUTE(
        IF(
            RIGHT($Setup.BorrowerPortalSettings__c.Lead_Borrower_Home_Url__c, 1) = "/",
            LEFT(
                $Setup.BorrowerPortalSettings__c.Lead_Borrower_Home_Url__c,
                LEN($Setup.BorrowerPortalSettings__c.Lead_Borrower_Home_Url__c) - 1
            ),
            $Setup.BorrowerPortalSettings__c.Lead_Borrower_Home_Url__c
        ),
        "/s",
        "/apex/LeadBorrowerDocumentPortal"
    ) & "?id=" & Portal_Hash_Parameter__c
)
